title: Add staged official ACP v1 stdio interoperability without changing legacy wire APIs
goal: Vision: V-6. Preserve all Susi capabilities while correcting verified Agent Client Protocol wire incompatibilities. This slice is not full ACP conformance: mandatory MCP stdio-server bridging remains outstanding.

reuse.searched: Existing AcpEngine session admission, bounded history, prompt executor callbacks and shared cancellation tokens; existing public AcpStdioTransport and CLI wiring; official Apache-2.0 ACP schema/docs at 13b765828f961812f0c78ae577220e994209fa2f (2026-11-14).
reuse.reason: A transport-local adapter reuses existing state/execution and preserves legacy HTTP/public wire contracts. No external code/schema copied into the repository or dependencies added.

limitations: Nonempty mcpServers explicitly refused pending mandatory MCP stdio bridge; no full ACP baseline/certification claim.
Resource links are preserved as references for the existing text executor; this adapter does not fetch URIs.
Cancellation and EOF cleanup are cooperative; a non-cooperative executor can delay scoped worker joining.
Parent owns integration, pushes and external coordination; scoped local WIP commits authorized for Mandate 82 synchronization.
Inbound validation checks required fields and supported content, not the entire official schema; optional client capability/info fields are unused and treated as unsupported.
Generic blocking reader/writer can delay total return; cancellation signalling is independent of output locks, but an already in-flight write cannot be revoked.

cli_binary.smoke: Actual binary numeric v1 initialize/session-new and legacy initialize; exits 0, no stdout banners/trailing output, no paid inference

validation.format: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed

official_schema.validator: Preinstalled jsonschema Draft202012Validator, audit-only external pin; no repo dependency/spec imports
official_schema.claim: Wire sample shape checks only, not normative full ACP certification

review_regressions: Malformed idless notification gets no response
Exact cwd including trailing space admitted/stored without mutation
Exact opaque session ID rejects padded aliases
Frame acquisition bounded before parsing including no-newline input; overflow rejects connection/tail
Cancellation and EOF signal cooperative workers independently of blocked stdout
Canonical final output retained for empty, partial, full, multi-block and divergent deltas; divergent final uses official distinct messageId
Async output failure cancels other turns while reader held after worker sweep; queued prompt after closure never executes
validation.independent_review: http_dedup cleared all production blockers; final queued-prompt regression additionally asserts zero completed/cancelled turns and messages for C after join.

source_delta.note: Positive standards-compatibility addition, not a line-count reduction; every new helper/test counted. No existing tests removed or dependencies changed.

handoff.status: Verified and ready for parent integration; independent reviewer cleared production findings.
handoff.artifacts: Private acpv1-state schema-validation.json, schema-transcript.json, cli-validation.json, cli-schema-transcript.json and full origin-relative acpv1.patch
